entries.sql: CREATE FUNCTION normalize_status(text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$SELECT lower($1)$$
entries.query: SELECT normalize_status('ReAdY') AS value, normalize_status(NULL) AS absent

entries.sql: CREATE FUNCTION second_status(text, text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql AS $$SELECT upper($2)$$
entries.query: SELECT second_status('ignored','Ready') AS value, second_status('ignored',NULL) AS absent

entries.sql: CREATE FUNCTION status_label(text, text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql AS $$SELECT concat_ws(' ', $1, $2)$$
entries.query: SELECT status_label('Ready','Now') AS value, status_label(NULL,NULL) AS absent

entries.sql: CREATE FUNCTION status_label_nested(text, text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql AS $$SELECT concat_ws(':', lower($1), coalesce($2, 'missing'))$$
entries.query: SELECT status_label_nested('ReAdY',NULL) AS value, status_label_nested(NULL,'Now') AS absent

entries.sql: CREATE FUNCTION clamp_amount(numeric, numeric, numeric) RETURNS numeric LANGUAGE sql AS $$SELECT least(greatest($1, $2), $3)$$
entries.query: SELECT clamp_amount(10.25,0.5,5.75)::text AS value, clamp_amount(NULL,0.5,5.75)::text AS absent

entries.sql: CREATE FUNCTION add_amounts(numeric, numeric) RETURNS numeric LANGUAGE sql AS $$SELECT $1+$2$$
entries.query: SELECT add_amounts(9007199254740993.0001,0.0002)::text AS value, add_amounts(NULL,1)::text AS absent

entries.sql: CREATE FUNCTION shift_amount(numeric) RETURNS numeric LANGUAGE sql AS $$SELECT 1 + arg1$$
CREATE FUNCTION normalize_named_status(status_text text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql AS $$SELECT lower(status_text)$$
entries.query: SELECT normalize_named_status('ReAdY') AS value, normalize_named_status(NULL) AS absent

probes.sql: CREATE FUNCTION normalize_status(text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql AS $$SELECT lower($1)$$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION normalize_status(text) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql AS $$SELECT 1$$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION normalize_named_status(other_name text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql AS $$SELECT lower(other_name)$$
CREATE FUNCTION missing_argument(text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql AS $$SELECT $2$$

overload.sql: SELECT normalize_status('ReAdY') AS value, normalize_status(2.25)::text AS amount
